finding: src/anomaly/identities.py:17 P7 completion does not validate the identities or existence of the outputs that README advertises.
rationale: The blocker is reachable because load_snapshot derives completion invalidation solely from changed_identities, P7 requires only the gate_b identity, and that identity hashes only .anomaly/receipts/gate-b.json; no upstream guard revalidates findings/findings.json, findings/report.md, findings/unresolved.md, findings/charts, or .anomaly/receipts/charts.json before project_readme preserves Status: complete and its output links.

evidence.output: IDENTITY_PHASES assigns only "gate_b": "P7". changed_identities iterates that table and invalidates only when artifact_identity differs or is absent. _identity_files maps gate_b solely to (".anomaly/receipts/gate-b.json",).
load_snapshot calls changed_identities(... through_phase=completed_phase(state)); if no mapped identity changed, completed remains P7 and project_readme(root, state, completed) runs.

The complete projection advertises findings/findings.json, findings/report.md, and findings/unresolved.md, and sets Status to complete whenever completed is P7 and snapshot status is complete; it performs no existence or digest validation of those targets.

The P7 owner write set explicitly includes findings/findings.json, findings/report.md, findings/unresolved.md, findings/charts, .anomaly/receipts/gate-b.json, .anomaly/receipts/charts.json, events, and README, confirming the omitted artifacts are authoritative P7 outputs.

The completion test checks output existence only immediately after generation and resumes without mutating outputs; the P7 invalidation test mutates only gate-b.json. There is no consumer test deleting or changing each advertised/authoritative P7 output after completion.
